description: Spans nest: an inner 12px span in an outer 24px one, each with its own box.

florui.css: .p { width: 280px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .o { font-size: 24px; background-color: #ffe9c0; } .i { font-size: 12px; background-color: #c0e8ff; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 1.59% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 3.34% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
